transcript.text: Hi everyone. As you know, my commercial popcorn machine is available for one neighborhood fundraiser this Saturday, and I'll be making the final decision on who gets to use it and on what terms. Both Rosa and Dev have expressed interest, so I'd like to hear from each of you before I commit. Rosa, could you lay out your plans for the machine — how you'd transport it, power it at the venue, and any terms you're proposing? Dev, same goes for you — please share your terms and practical arrangements. And if there's a venue electrician available, I'd like to hear from them too about power setup at the fundraiser location. I want to make sure transport and power are fully settled before Saturday, so let's get all the details on the table.

transcript.text: My offer is $275 plus three meal vouchers for you, Mina. I'll pick up the machine Friday evening and return it Saturday night.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: My offer is $250 in cash for the Saturday rental. I can collect the machine myself and return it myself, so transport is fully handled on my end.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Mina, I inspected the fundraiser venue and its only usable outlet is on a 15-amp circuit. Your commercial popcorn machine will need a dedicated portable generator — that outlet won't safely power it. So whoever you choose, they'll need to arrange a portable generator before Saturday, or the machine can't be used there.
